widgets_values:
head_swap: Replace the head in Picture 1 with the head from Picture 2 while keeping Picture 1’s lighting, background, environment, pose, and composition. Preserve Picture 2’s hair, eye color, nose structure, skin tone, and realistic human facial features, and match Picture 1’s gaze, head rotation, and micro-expression. Keep the skin tone consistent across all exposed skin and blend the result seamlessly with high realism, sharp detail, and natural proportions. Remove any hair style from Picture 1 and replace it with the hairstyle of Picture 2. Copy the expression from Picture 1 into the final image. Ensure the head size is proportional to the body, and reduce it if necessary.
Style: ultra realistic photograph, professional photography, sharp detail, natural lighting, photorealistic textures.
Portrait: natural skin texture, soft studio lighting, sharp eyes and hair detail.
Fashion/product: photorealistic product photography, sharp fabric texture, clean professional lighting.
Concept art: same composition and character, cinematic lighting, photorealistic.
